summary: The deploy parcours opens one fresh owner session per run (agent:main:recette-deploy:<UTC stamp>) instead of reusing agent:main:recette-deploy, and treats « est indisponible », « est toujours indisponible » and « est momentanément indisponible » as a broken reply.
reason: S24 31/10 00:50 Tunis: deploying aff8fe95 (#475, #476, #479) was rolled back on write_recap. The reused recette session still held the refused agenda calls of the dbe0f455 run; the brain answered « l’accès Agenda est toujours indisponible » without calling any tool, so the run judged the session history, not the deployed code. owner_read passed on « est indisponible pour le moment ».

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-deploy-parcours.py
tests.evidence: 8 tests (2 new): the two S24 replies of 31/10 are broken_reply; two runs use two distinct session keys. Already registered in ci.yml.

capabilities.reason: Deployment acceptance only; no route or capability.

architecture.reason: Same parcours owner and paths; one session key per run instead of a shared one.

limitations: One short owner session per deployment; existing session pruning (7 days) removes them.
rollback: Revert this commit; the next deployment reuses the shared session again.
